one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three provider resources in total, ALL sharing this session's single $15.0446 ceiling. The three are host draws inside one launcher session, NOT three scientific attempts. A create request that returns no provider resource id created nothing and is not a provider resource. The next resource is not created until the provider confirms the previous one is no longer billing.
one_use.machine_readable: the four values above are copied into the authorization as C2ResourceScope and checked by resource_scope_gate before provider creation.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.
one_use.retry_rule: under the 2026-09-16 campaign decision, an ordinary failure BEFORE the beam search or any scientific measurement begins is an engineering failure: preserve evidence, provider-confirmed teardown, reconcile spend, diagnose, minimal repair, fresh executable identity, fresh run identity and a complete fresh chain, and continue automatically -- but only while the next full $15.0446 ceiling still fits inside the $16.20 campaign envelope. Once the beam search has begun, NO automatic formal retry is authorized: preserve, tear down, reconcile and return.

It is not behavioural recovery evidence and must not be described as a demonstrated student capability improvement. If B remains preferred the result is a constrained search-stage null under this space and this cheap metric; if a structurally different C is promising, its exact path, spec and artifact identity are frozen and it remains search-stage evidence. C1 remains closed and frozen.
